experiment.objective: Calibrate fixed five-token hash prefetch against the default-off storage-aware adaptive selector across the five R0 domains
experiment.control: fixed five-token DSpark with hash exact prefetch
experiment.candidate: adaptive DSpark prefix with hash exact prefetch

evidence_limits: This is one ABBA wave per workload, not a formal repeated-wave result.
Prompts contain 128 tokens and outputs contain at most eight tokens; this does not represent the historical 4K/256-token matrix.
Each workload has an untimed same-prompt warmup, but the operating-system page cache is not controlled or purged.
Process disk counters include all reads attributed to the process and do not isolate physical expert-file SSD traffic.
Adaptive selection only models the three exact target hash layers and still computes the complete five-position DSpark draft.
Timing, process-disk, and peak-memory changes remain exploratory until repeated waves establish stable paired results.
